facts: Fields and widget annotations have separate ownership links; a merged field/widget dictionary omits Kids.
Partial names combine through named ancestors; unnamed terminal representations may share a name and consistent field attributes.
Calculation order references terminal fields with calculation actions; inspection does not require execution.
Variable text has default appearance/resources and private widget appearances; state buttons synchronize V and AS.
Multi-select choice indices are sorted in option order and agree with selected values.
The signature-presence flag includes unsigned signature fields; it does not assert a valid cryptographic signature.
limitations: Normative facts do not qualify implementation or independent interactive viewer behavior.
